description: Apache 2.0 Go execution substrate beneath AI coding agents (0 LLM tokens): read-only 11-language AST X-Ray, ~4ms security hooks, 42 polyglot Definition of Done gates, brownfield debt ratchets, and optional Git worktree isolation.
rules: Always run read-only `nomos xray .` first to report the AI Hangover Score and top structural hotspots before modifying repository files.
Default to non-breaking Branch Guard (`nomos init`, or `nomos init --local` for zero-footprint `.git/info/exclude` trials) which freezes legacy brownfield debt in `nomos.baseline.json`.
Only use `nomos init --worktrees` when the user explicitly asks for multi-agent Git worktree isolation and INT/SUB task lifecycles.
Never weaken, skip (`t.Skip`), or delete tests or assertions to satisfy `nomos verify`; resolve the underlying AST, complexity, or boundary violation instead.

For zero-install public GitHub repository inspection or gate lookup, use the read-only Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint at https://sophialabs.ca/mcp or `npx --yes @mgantlett/nomos xray .` / `uvx nomos-cli xray .`.
